1. Above - connects the phrase "the clouds" to the main clause, indicating location.
2. with - connects the noun "contrasting" to the noun phrase "the stormy scene below," indicating accompaniment or comparison.
3. through - connects the verb "navigate" to the noun phrase "these layers of the atmosphere," indicating movement or path.
4. of - connects the noun "layers" to the noun "the atmosphere," indicating possession or composition.
5. for - connects the adjective "smooth" (via the noun "flight") to the noun phrase "all the passengers aboard," indicating purpose or beneficiary.
6. aboard - connects the noun phrase "all the passengers" to the implied location (the aircraft), indicating position.
7. in - connects the noun phrase "fluffy things" to the noun "the sky," indicating location.
8. from - connects the noun phrase "the sky" to the verb "comes," indicating source or origin.
